names: Domingos Augusto Alves da Costa Oliveira
summary: Domingos Oliveira was an army officer who was President of the Ministry from January 1930 until July 1932, the last head of government of the Ditadura Nacional before Salazar took the post. He is in the atlas as the holder of that office in the two years before the Estado Novo; the run that drafted this record could not state his birth or death year closer than a range of a few years, which is what his interval says.
